# LinkedIn policy and Sales Navigator references

Checked: 2026-11-14.

## Official Sales Navigator filters

LinkedIn's current help page describes lead filters including current company, current title, function, seniority, geography, industry, company headcount, changed jobs in the last 90 days, posted on LinkedIn in the last 30 days, profile views, buyer intent, connections and shared experiences. Account filters include headquarters, industry, headcount, annual revenue, department growth, job opportunities, recent activity and buyer intent. Availability can vary by plan and interface rollout.

https://www.linkedin.com/help/sales-navigator/answer/a1461507

## Search workflow

LinkedIn's guidance recommends starting with one to three filters, reviewing the results, then refining. Saved lead/account searches can provide updates when new matches appear.

https://www.linkedin.com/help/sales-navigator/answer/a735730/search-for-leads-and-accounts-in-sales-navigator

## User Agreement and prohibited automation

LinkedIn's User Agreement prohibits scraping/copying services data and unauthorized automated methods for adding/downloading contacts, sending messages, or creating engagement. Do not use browser bots or scripts to automate these activities.

https://www.linkedin.com/legal/user-agreement

LinkedIn's help page also explains that third-party software such as crawlers, bots, browser plugins and extensions that scrape or automate activity are not permitted.

https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a1341387/prohibited-software-and-extensions

Use the official UI for search and manual review. Do not bypass login walls, CAPTCHA, rate limits or access controls.
